description: Nine rows of gain and offset on one input each, with outputs normalled downward so that a row with no cable of its own is added into the next output below it

params.text: Scales that row's input, -2 to 2 times
Adds a fixed voltage to that row after its gain, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: That row's signal; with nothing patched the row contributes only its offset

outputs.text: That row's signal plus every row above it whose own output has no cable, clamped to -10 to 10V; with no cable in this jack the row is passed down instead of being sent here

notes: leaving an output unpatched is what makes the module a mixer: each row is summed into the next output below that does have a cable
with Row 1 as Master VCA on, the first output carries the first row's own processed signal at ten times the master value rather than joining the mix
menu: Row 1 as Master VCA — turns the first row into a level control over all the others, its own processed signal scaled by a tenth multiplying every row below it
